items.text: She does look nice, I grant you. Lovely even. But she doesn’t look comfortable, not at all. I think we look our loveliest when we are comfortable in our own skin and our own clothes. I think Hannah needs to listen to the person who told her to be herself, regardless of who that is.
Fuck house words, they are growing strong regardless. Fight me on this!!!!
Fuck house words, they are growing strong regardless. Fight me on this. Or at least Gilly is...

I think that was kind of the point. They showed all the characters ignoring the true threat so much that they even made the audience forget... In spite of the fact they shoved it down our throats in the very first scene.
Umm... I can’t help thinking that deliberately giving an innocent little girl the kiss of death counts as hurting her, whether it takes some time to take effect or not. But that’s just me.
Cersei and Tyrion’s love child is actually quite pretty aight. She fooked the wrong brother!
Also, Tormund and Brienne should definitely NOT get together. I just decided this. Just now. For no particular reason.
Second best casting of the season. First was broody baby snow.
“You know nothin, jon snow” - anyone/everyone.
If the intrigue and politics hadn’t been so very interesting, it wouldn’t have been so very distracting.
Sacrilegious as this might sound, there is unfortunately going to come a point in the next few hours where any leaks will be all but pointless.
And soon our long night ends and our watch begins...and then quickly ends forever. 😭
He will live. He has to. And after all he does know how. All he’s ever done is live a ripe old age.
The only day that those words would have made sense was 2 weeks ago.
Honestly wasn’t expecting the comedic moments, but they were gold.
It’s actually eerie how well that music fit for that scene, even without editing.
NK is an equal opportunity enslaver.
This...is a very good point. Time to start hoping that dragons don’t have the same memories as Cersei’s absent elephants.
...or try out this flirting thing humans do. Idk.
And the crossbow he’s going north with has been massively downgraded too.

He last saw her when she was a little kid, give the man a damn minute to catch up. He can’t know something that he literally can’t know yet. Raven scrolls are like texting in the noughties, no room to elaborate.
Idk, he looks kinda turned on to me. Like, he just turned back on...

items.title: Was it absolutely necessary for Rhaegal to nearly drop Jon (his new rider of less than a minute) in order to full on turn sideways just as they passed Winterfell to make sure that nobody missed the hot new accessory he had on his back? Someone was showing off.
items.text: Was it absolutely necessary for Rhaegal to nearly drop Jon (his new rider of less than a minute) in order to full on turn sideways just as they passed Winterfell to make sure that nobody missed the hot new accessory he had on his back? Someone was showing off.
Maybe if Top Gun and a certain magic carpet had a love child.
Early seasons Tyrion? Yes, I agree! That is absolutely how it could happen. Later seasons Tyrion? I’m less convinced that he both drinks AND knows things now.
😂 If he wanted it off, he was fully capable of making that happen in spectacular fashion. That was one proud af dragon.
“Take that, Balerion the Black Dread reborn! I got me Aegon Targaryen the sixth!”
Yeahhh... Still a fuckton of shade thrown.
We had 3 child heads of northern houses, now we’re one down. We can’t lose all of them...right?! 😢
It’s torture. And in just over a month when we all get to simultaneously begin our permanent state of GoT withdrawal. Happy thought.
That day already came when he chose duty over Ygritte. What may happen is him having to choose AGAIN, and this time, choosing differently.

I think it was both awesome and cringy at the same time. They were showing two people in love. People in love, especially new and shiny love, can be cringy af to the rest of us. So...accurate portrayal.
I think I can manage to explain this using less words:      no.
If this happens it will be the new wight hunt for playing fast and loose with timelines.
The true secret of defeating the NK revealed!
Westeros needs to up their publishing skills, so much juicy gossip rag material being wasted. Though they probably need to up their literacy levels first.

I viewed it more that an impromptu dragon date in the middle of battle prep was being excused by reasoning of cheering the dragons up by paying some attention to them. Rhaegal did seem pretty eager and hyped. Also, do we really think they had sex? If they actually showed us a cave, I’d absolutely buy that they did, but otherwise, the environment just didn’t seem conducive...for more than one reason.
The beyond the wall mission to capture a wight and subsequent timeline defying dragon rescue.
Thighs (and buns) of steel! But seriously, what are the chances that someone does something as sensible as using the words dragon and saddle in the same sentence this season?
This this world being a Targaryen is entirely an excuse.
When I’m doing literally anything, and make eye contact with my dog. Pets and stalkers are the same thing in different clothes.
One proud af dragon. Finally stepping out of big brother’s shadow.
Yep, if they were ever going to exist they have now gone the way of Cersei’s elephants.

Cat had a MASSIVE blind spot when it came to her family, duty and honor (specifically who and what SHE perceived those things to be) and wasn’t nearly as smart as she thought she was, her very questionable actions during the Wot5K’s prove this. Ned did the right thing not telling her, she may not have deliberately betrayed him or Jon, but she could easily have effectively fucked them all over just like she did when ned and the girls were in KL and she took Tyrion. And let’s not forget her great friendship with her old friend the entirely trustworthy Littlefinger. Ha! Ned telling Cat would have just spelled an earlier doom for them all!

He knew nothing (except the biggest secret in the 7K) The show has deliberately kept him oblivious to almost everything since half way through last season. Only way for him to not learn about the outcome of the biggest battle in hundreds of years, even while spending months in the hub of all knowledge and then subsequently travelling across the country in the wake of that battle. Had to stay oblivious so it could all come out at the most dramatic time, regardless of realism. But no, realistically I don’t think he knew Jon was unknowingly fucking his aunt.
I think it’s just a dagger and I think it’s her same one he had on the wight hunt. He brings it out when shits about to get real.
Proof positive that Arya’s storyline has been largely separate from most of the politics and players of the game of thrones.
It could still happen, would be a good comeuppance for his flaky idea of loyalty.
Call me Craster because at this point I’d be happy to offer up this whiny baby as a sacrifice to the NK.
Yeah, let’s definitely take that name off the table for boatbaby.
He did really well, and he must have been under so much pressure to get it just right. A scene that people have been anticipating for more than 20 years!
If this STAYS one the saddest scenes in the show I’ll be happy. Alas, I think the chances of it being wildly surpassed are high. 😢

I really hope we get a scene of him specifically focusing on his  new knowledge of his mother identity. We didn’t really get a true reaction of him responding to learning his mothers name, because that was near the beginning and shit still wasn’t making sense to him at that point. Around the time Sam said the words “real father” that’s when some level of (painful) understanding started to come over him.

I suppose it was meant to demonstrate the pack survives and Arya and Sansa have worked their shit out now. But yeah, it was a stretch AT BEST. And if they had to put in such a questionable cringy line in, could they have put it anywhere else except in the much anticipated Jon and Ayra reunion that we have been waiting so many damn years for?!
That’s officially a cuteness overload.
Best part. I liked the eye twitching.
It would have just been assumed for many years. Nobody believed anything else was out there. You get killed/disappear north of the wall, wildlings did it. Simple as that.
I like it, I doubt there is time for it, but I like it. Though I don’t think Tormund would know what the fuck happened to his son. They would need exposition Bran to fill in the deets.
I am looking forward to the union of northern lords and truth nearly as much as I am looking forward to the reunion of ghost and screen time.
We FINALLY have actual images of Jon riding a dragon and we’re still using this manip?

I thought that too until we saw him wearing the exact same thing pre reveal. They were actually giving me whiplash with Jon’s dress this episode. Stark dress for arrival, non stark dress for dragon ride, then stark dress again for reveal. Not sure what the point of that was other than to confuse us.
This could actually happen, and I would be hear for it. Like husband, like wife. More suited for each other than they ever realised in life.
Exactly. They are particularly big on parallels and call backs this season.

I don’t think Rhaegal is Rhaegar reborn, but I think he would be one proud af daddy/bro. Targs be Targs. Only reason Rhaegar didn’t marry Dany is she wasn’t born yet. It was kind of a deal breaker for the relationship.

If that’s the case, I do not like our albino friend’s chances of surviving that dramatic scene. Maybe he should just stay hidden at this point. It worked for Benjen for years, but then...on screen is not a safe place to be.

If they really cram a whole lot of people into the place filled with dead people so that they will be safe against the threat that raises dead people, without even a hint of concern about the current dead people there that could be raised...
This is like watching him try to wink. Cute af.

This season is super condensed. The whole series is really, when compared to the books. Sacrifices must be made. Reveal of truth to Dany will happen soon and instead of her having totally legitimate doubts about the trustworthiness of the news, she will probably quickly realise how much sense it makes, given her dragons reactions to him, and accept that it’s the truth, which will save time. How exactly she will react to that truth is another matter.

This. She said it. She never did receive a formal education. And what little Viserys taught her, I think she has rightly come to question all of it. Everything she does, she does more out of instinct that anything else and her bond with her dragons would be the epitome of this.
Yep. Only after the first episode and the tainted reunion scene, I unfortunately don’t think we can rule out Arya having issues too.
A snail would have worked too.
Why not both? Follow House Seaworth’s example. A dollar sign on a snail!
“I’ll kill them all tomorrow”
Based on that weird ass reunion dialogue it will be “Sure, you will absolutely always and completely be my brother and a Stark, no matter what...if you renounce your Targ fam right this minute.”
Ghost!!!
Wait, a spoiler tag on a post discussing a character that bit it 5 seasons ago? Is this really what is expected outside this sub?

Good character, I’ll give you. But way overrated as a political genius. Chaos isn’t difficult, he basically just went around behind the scenes smashing shit up. For years. It’s the rebuilding shit, and doing so to one’s own advantage, that’s the hard part and as soon as he started to really make his big power taking moves, he quickly fell off his precious ladder of chaos.

Show runners had a problem on their hands. They had an extremely big and depressing bombshell pending, but they also wanted to spend some time on reunions, dragon riding and political crap...so they naturally chose to basically ignore the extremely big and depressing bombshell. When it comes to the reunions and dragon ride, I’m not mad about it. The political crap on the other hand...
A girl ain’t no one no more.

Yeah, this is pretty much the vibe I got from episode 1. I will be very surprised if they are planning to do anything really important with his character at this stage. Seems to have basically served his purpose.

items.title: When Jon introduces Dany to a hopefully very big and impressive Ghost, will Jon say something like “don’t be afraid” like she did when Drogon was being lurky?
items.text:
When Jon introduces Dany to a hopefully very big and impressive Ghost, will Jon say something like “don’t be afraid” like she did when Drogon was being lurky?
Or maybe a line about Ghost not being a beast to him? I have to admit, I don’t know why she would call Ghost a beast in the first place after correcting Jon last season. But with the writing style so far this season, I have to admit it’s possible.

Note: I’m just going to assume that this VERY needed scene is going to exist until I’m screwed over to the contrary.
It’s a dagger he’s had for ages but doesn’t always wear.
That’s better than playing the YouTube music vid of it on repeat like I’ve been doing.
It’s good to love what you do for a living.
Reposts are one thing. 2 posts within an hour are another.
I find this relevant.

Does it still count as a dracarys if neither Dany or a dragon have anything to do with it? And does it need to be a death the involves fire? Because littles Ned’s first death probably didn’t. Just trying to figure out the rules here.
And his mother’s tomb. Excellent cinematography on that shot.
I reckon he’ll go right in for scritches just like Rhaegal.
The limbs certainly were. Were those people mainlining rocket fuel before they were killed to deal with the stress of their impending doom?
More like when Dany finds out he’s a Targ. There is only one person in the whole story who MIGHT want Jon to fully embrace his Targ side...and it’s not Jon.
I’m bad at reading dragon expressions. I still can’t decide if he looked thirsty or threatening...or both?
Maybe it was more like, interested? Mommy and new Daddy giving a birds and the bees demo. “Oh, so that’s how it’s done.” Very Targ.
Any excuse.
Umm, her and her brother were on the run, constantly moving from place to place and sometimes on the streets. Can’t have been that formal.
That would have been nice, but much less dramatic. Bran only does overly dramatic now.

Am I the only one who thinks it would be really shitty if they only work things out after the baby reveal? I think that would massively detract from their relationship. And thankfully, it’s not the trend in their relationship thus far. Jon doesn’t bend the knee until she’s agreed to help, and it makes him bending the knee mean that much more. Jon doesn’t find out he’s a King until he’s already given up his crown to her, and it makes the reveal mean more. I think they will work everything out and THEN Dany will tell him about the baby, and it will make the reveal mean more. Fuck Jon staying with the aunt he mistakenly fucked just because he accidentally (not) got her preggers. Fuck. That. Some song of ice and fire that would be.
Yep, I definitely see the clear and undeniable signs of very early pregnancy in this posterior shot.
The very first walker killed was by Sam...with dragonglass.
And when they removed his frozen furs, that’s when she finally saw the damage for herself.
But is he really going to wear that damn think cape on a dragon again? Dragon training 101 must have taught him it isn’t exactly aerodynamic.
In Jon’s defence, Rhaegal did not exactly go easy on his new rider.
Removing the power and politics of a Queen with dragons (if that’s possible) she is also a Mommy who is really proud of her babies.
Riiight... because the NK is absolutely a totally normal run of the mill invader.
This entirely explains my very mixed feelings about seeing Ghost again. I kind of want the dragons to go fuck off and hide too, I feel like they are pretty doomed too if they stick around.
To be fair, he’s been outsmarted more than once in recent times.

Thankfully, I don’t see how there could possibly be time for a “marry other people” plot travesty. At most Dany might suggest Jon should marry someone else to further they’re family seeing at she can’t...2 seconds before she finds out she’s pregnant.
More genuine emotion than we have seen from her in years, perhaps ever...certainly happy emotion.

But seriously, has Drogon ever given Dany such a *cough* rough ride? I think the nearest would be when he had to full on turn sideways to avoid the NK’s spear. But that was an actual emergency, Rhaegal did the same exact thing just for shits and giggles.
It wasn’t just you. We have yet to see Jon ride a Drogon. So far we have just seen Jon’s cape ride a Drogon.
Idk... He’s already getting pretty prime dragon ass, the man ain’t starving.
High quality might be a stretch, but still impressive if this really is from a porno.
I’d watch it.
And this is how one commits karmic suicide.
I’m guessing the snark level was high in WF during Jon’s absence.

They’ve had similar traumas, which is as far as anyone should bother going down the rabbit hole of comparing people’s traumas. I think part of the differing perception of their traumas comes from their journeys having been paced so differently. Best example is Dany being “sold and raped” right at the start of her journey and that happening relatively recently to Sansa. Makes it seem like Dany hasn’t gone through the same sort of thing, but it was just a longer time ago. That and idiots thinking it doesn’t even count because she developed Stockholm syndrome.
In the end the end, if the show runners have taught us nothing else, they have taught us that they don’t give a shit about geography. If they want to do it. They’ll do it. And I’m ok with it.

No, we are not. Funnily enough people who go through terrible trauma can still come out the other side of it as good and functional people. And if there are any remaining changes due to the trauma they suffered, sansa would be just as susceptible to them...and so would just about every other GoT character actually. Thrones verse be brutal.
I can get onboard with that. So as that ridiculously ridiculous first ride amazingly didn’t make him fall to his death, does that mean he passed the test? Dragon daddy confirmed?
So, are they stupid cunts because of the brain damage or were they stupid before they decided to give themselves brain damage? Idk. This is a chicken or the egg situation.

She will and probably quite a lot next ep. I’m looking at episode two as ‘the set up: part two’ They just split the two set up episodes evenly down the middle, like when a chapter gets too long, wasn’t time to do everyone and everything justice in the first.

Rather a different and disturbing source of her joy in that case. Here she is reuniting with a family member, back then she was cacking herself laughing at the death of a family member...or at least the irony of it.
Yep. All that and still this moment was the most genuine and heartfelt emotion form her.

So do I, but unfortunately both people are pretty high of my “there’s no time for that” list. Meera literally said it last season, they don’t need her anymore. And now that reveal has happened and apparently they have enough proof between sam and creepy bran, I don’t think they don’t need Howland either.

It shouldn’t have been the same scene. It should have been a nice reunion that was just about Jon and Arya. Maybe their next scene could have been something that communicated to Jon that his sisters were BFF’s now. But they combined them for time. Another example of this extremely condensed season.
“The north kinda sorta vaguely recalls, unless it’s convenient”
No, 3iBran, WE need to know!
I beg to differ, she looks a thousand times more terrifying in this picture.
Would this be a call back to Tywin thinking he could negotiate with Mance. Cersei actually thinking she could make a deal with the NK? That would be Cersei in a nutshell: Tywin but much stupider.

He literally found out 2 minutes before that Dany killed his father and brother, and with practically no context. No one can say that ANY person might not have acted just as unreasonable in those first few minutes of grief. Grief and reason Do. Not. Go. Together.
Though I wouldn’t  mind seeing him be introduced to longclaw the same way Slynt was, he’s wight bait now, there’s no denying it.

Brienne is probably going to see both Jamie AND Tormund again next episode. I want a scene with just the three of them, I REALLY want that scene. Bet there won’t damn well be time though. Especially not next episode, and any later scene would relay on all three of them surviving episode three. So, yeah...
Totally deliberate click-bait aside, it’s like Sam’s convo with Dany. Sometimes you *really* need to stick around for more information and context.
I can just see Brienne’s reaction in that scene, her face would turn into a beetroot!
THE END.
Least Dany doesn’t need to crane her neck quite as much as her goodsister did.
I know, until I saw this scene I kinda just thought Targs be Tiny.
One in every generation. Like aunt, like niece.
I’ve said it before, and I’ll say it again. Cersei is Tywin. But waaay dumber.
Yep, the subtly was off the scale. If Dany was 5-6 mentions worth of pregnant, the triplets would already be showing.
Don’t know what to think. Seems obvious. TOO obvious. Idk...
Well considering we’re probably not even going to be able to see episode 3 isn’t going to be so damn dark, I’d have to say yeah, confirmed.
Yep. They have literally stated that that is part of plan A. Obviously none of plan A is going to work.
Agree. And that is a travesty.
They are there, DnD just moved them. They did that to Jon too.
Not sure it qualifies, Jon was a pretty big part of their conversation.
Yeah, he was being so gentlemanly, and thus making Brienne so uncomfortable.
Still more subtle than Tormund.
The amazing thing was that he wasn’t *much* more subtle than Tormund.
And it’s deeply weird for her, and she calls him out on it. I love it.
“Last time I was here you killed my son.” I think Davos and Tyrion have another connection.

items.title: Ageism or Heightism?
items.text:
Ageism or Heightism?
Who thinks that this ridiculous outrage would be the same if Arya were simply taller? 

The fact that’s she’s a short woman, and always will be, even when (if) she becomes an old women, is helping people (casuals) not notice that she grew the fuck up.
Username does not check out. Don’t worry, Jamie wasn’t listening either.
Not to mention who her parents were.
Amazing. Everything you just said was wrong. 😂
If I have to choose between paying attention to the characters when they talk and paying attention to autocorrect,  I know my choice, a GoT expert should know theirs.
I noticed.
Noh
How can something be what I most want to see and what I least want to see, all at the same time?
Some points true, some points a stretch, some points drastically lacking context.
Accurate. Dany didn’t even get a full minute to properly think about it and react. Probably won’t next episode either.  Are we forgetting that Jon’s reaction wasn’t exactly joyful either?!
Accurate.

I mean, yeah, but it’s not like there aren’t any potential ulterior motives for a political player to want to have a nice little chat with an all knowing tree god. I’m surprised varys was cosying up episode one.

I mean do we really *know* that? For sure? He was human once and this is GoT verse. Two things that are standing against him. Plus he seemed to have a major yen for Craster’s incest spawn. An important question for the prequels, I think, or Bran...

items.title: This kills me. The look on his face as he gazes up at his Mother’s statue. His Mommy. Right below his feet the whole time. 😭😭😭
items.text: This kills me. The look on his face as he gazes up at his Mother’s statue. His Mommy. Right below his feet the whole time. 😭😭😭

Jon totally killed Olly. It’s true, and I’m not sad about it, fucked his shit right up. But there seem to be some very strange definitions of the word “adoption” going around. Also the word “unwanted”.
Lol. My headcanon is Lyanna being team Targ all the way. I don’t think she’d have a problem. People forget the “incest” in house stark. Her parents were cousins.

For me it’s the fact that she was dead the whole time, and Ned knew it. It’s the part of his lie that I just can’t get over no matter how necessary the rest was. It wasn’t like death was an uncommon thing, especially in a war. It wasn’t like people would go: “Your sister is dead *and* so Jon’s mother? What an unlikely coincidence! They simply *must* be the same person!!!” That part of the lie just seemed too cruel. Jon would have always cruelly hoped. 😢

No, we will not get all the talks we want, but surely they will throw us a bone or two before this is over? *The Reveal* still need to happen to more characters (the ones that survive episode 3) surely that will give a few opportunities for chats.  I mean if by chance Jaime lives, he’s one of the last people living who actually knew Rhaegar.
Sometimes we believe things because we *want* to believe them. Jon would have been no exception. He would have always wondered, always worried, always hoped... 😢
Well if we’re trying to pick the most compassionate family man, out of Craster and the NK, then that’s a much more difficult choice.
Yeah, it was some pretty skeletal skeletons that attacked Bran and co north of the wall. Me worries bones are not exempt from the NK. Me wonders why all the characters seem to think they are.
My baby just wanted his Mommy to comfort him, just once in his life! 😭

Either way a child would have grown up dreaming his mom might come back to him one day. I’m only talking about one small part of Neds lie, and that was not telling Jon that that was never going to happen.
*wight. Me agrees by me also thinks DnD are going to make up their own rules as they go along to fit with what they want to do.

I see what Ned did, and it was clearly difficult. Though also true that Jon wasn’t the only one he was protecting. But as last posted pointed out, there were also extra risks that came with Jon not even being told she was dead. He really could have run away in a fit of teenage angst and gone searching for his long lost mother, drawing even more attention to both himself and the identity of his mother.
I feel ya.
Lol, I wasn’t sure what the insinuation was here. Gendry is bad in bed like his Dad, or extremely virile like his Dad, and Arya is 💯% knocked up? Both?
We haven’t seen much from the NW for a bit, they might have gotten around to having a vote. I don’t think he would have had much competition.
Tyrion definitely knew, if Dany doesn’t...

Frequently they can’t have the characters directly say everything we with they would. But it was done well with the cinematography, the audience definitely knew the significance of where this reveal was happening, and Jon got there too, Dany finding him in what I’m sure would become his new favourite brooding spot if they were sticking around WF.
I mean there was a *bit* of snow for the BotB, but yeah, doesn’t really fit. But how did he see the snow and not the zombies?
Would it be too Disney for them to just share a job that’s way to big, lonely and thankless for one person anyway?
He’s catching up to Dany. ...The White Wolf, The Resurrected...My Little Crow... 😂
I have to admit on show that has brought foreshadowing to a whole new level, his name worries me a great deal.
So it’s Jon’s fault he’s such a creeper.

Looks about right. Dany needs to take a moment and remember who her man really is. And I think she will, eventually, she just needs a death not imminent minute to assimilate everything. Something she’s not going to get for awhile. Bran really does have the most conveniently dramatic terrible timing.
Yeah, if a fan fav has to bite the dust in a spectacularly tragic way in order to protect boat baby’s parents...bye Tyrion.
You can’t just sort shit out too cleanly and too early! Where’s your respect for crippling heart wrenching soul destroying angst!?

Been dissected to death. It’s Dragonstone, fireplaces match. They both survive episode 3. Not exactly surprising as they are the main characters and there will be another 3 episodes still to go. Plus they have build up a fuck load of reveal angst, they aren’t just going to waste that by making the point moot if one of them dies immediately.
Yep, pretty much the message I’ve been getting from...everywhere. People losing their minds at this is a simply fabulous example of this ridiculous thinking though.
And hopefully that’s all it is.
Me either. The better part of an episode, in which they are not busy with battle, is almost inevitable, but after that it will get old REAL fast.

I don’t like his chances, as this pic illustrates. Those labels have been ganging up on him for years, I don’t think they are going to stop being great big bully’s anytime soon. Especially as they keep getting reinforcements.
IMO she looked plenty motivated just by Gendry’s hot bod, that and all the impending doom.

If other characters can teleport themselves the length of westeros by under or entirely non explained means, we might just have to except that Bran and is chair can pop up around WF wherever he likes. It’s answers we just ain’t ever going to get. There’s no time for that.
This pic is covered with mould it’s so old.
While totally true, I feel like Jon went about things less stupidly that Robb, not that that was hard to do.
Both of them seem to have blind spots in their supposedly vast knowledge.
Ghost ain’t sitting out this fight.
That could still happen in the crypts...😬

Jaime has a sole consistent character trait, doing stupid things for love. Tyrion may have thought he had finally broken that by leaving Cersei and coming north. This is where he realises...nope...just a different love now. *Very* different.

She didn’t even get a minute to go through the stages. We saw some anger, denial, grief and sadness. We’ll probably see some more of all given the *far less* than ideal circumstances that she now gets to process this news in. But once she gets a goddamn minute in peace, I don’t think the acceptance will take long.
Well, she was on that dick like 2 minutes later, it would seem that hearing this definitely wasn’t a turn *off* for her...
That does sound like a Ser Brienne level of stubborn perseverance.
I loved it. Her whole demeanour changed so suddenly. A reminder that very little genuinely surprises her anymore.

I too interpret that look as having far more to do with impending doom than sexual dissatisfaction. But in meme land the other interpretation is impossible to ignore. Think of it as a distraction from our impending doom next episode.
*visibly confused face*

THIS is why mad queen theories are such bullshit. If they wanted to portray her going mad as a real possibility, they would be hyping her doing something that was at least slightly mad, instead of merely being the sword behind two of the most (foolishly) justifiable deaths in the entire series of GoT.
Bad...really bad, but I’ll give it to you. Upvote.
Don’t joke! There is a real risk that they might delve into that bag of balls again before the season is over.

It reminds me of Dany’s thoughts. “Who would ever dare love a dragon?”

*”Who would ever dare love a faceless man?”*
Sansa, Arya and Jon all had statues made for the crypt promo.
Here’s hoping she has significantly fewer nephews/cousins/brothers by the end of the episode.
No!!!
Yes..but also, no.
No way my pup dies off screen like the blackfish. Lies!!!
